assumption_ledger.note: Policy requires privacy review signoff; current status unknown
Policy requires security review signoff; current status unknown
No audit ticket has been created yet; must be assigned before activation per audit_log_rules
Extent of C3 data redaction in sandbox package must be validated

mitigations: Require dual approval from privacy and security review before activation
Mandate audit ticket linkage before the exception is activated
Enforce 24-hour expiry with least-privilege sandbox-only scope
Use redacted replay package instead of raw production token
primary_risk.statement: Granting vendor access to C3 customer replay traces creates privacy and security exposure if controls are not properly enforced.

ranking.summary: Redacted sandbox export with dual approval follows the narrow path explicitly allowed by access-policy v2.1 while meeting the vendor's operational need.
Sanitized sample bundle is always policy-safe but provides less operational value than a sandbox replay package when policy permits the latter.
Direct local override token is technically capable but forbidden by policy v2.1 which prohibits minting direct production tokens for third parties.
Denying without fallback over-corrects when a narrower policy-compliant path (P2) exists per the runbook guidance.
